decision.text: D1: CARRIER. A 'personal' message to 'cc' through cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py RemoteBus.post. Measured 2026-10-27: bus.post fires delivery only for 'personal'; 'announce' reaches no subscriber and the bus has no subscribe. Akien's words: 'a message to your bus address'. The address 'cc' is one module constant, so moving to subscription later changes one line.
